court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
trial_court: Principal Judge, Family Court, District Lucknow in Criminal Case No.1039 of 2005
case_name: Smt. Roli Kulshreshtha vs State Of U.P. And Anr.

parties.respondent_defendant: State of U.P. and Anr. (husband, government)

facts_of_case: The wife filed an application under Section 125 Cr.P.C. claiming maintenance from her husband who had allegedly misused her business and income. The trial court decided the case on 18.10.2017. This appeal is against that order.

legal_principles.principle: A party cannot be put at a disadvantageous position for a decree passed in their favour.
legal_principles.held: It has been argued that the court below took a contrary view while deciding the application under Section 125 Cr.P.C. which is beneficial legislation and it is always open to the court to weigh the evidences under Section 125 Cr.P.C. independently while deciding the issue of maintenance.

legal_principles.principle: A party who withdraws from the society of others must prove a reasonable excuse.
legal_principles.held: Explanation to Section 9 casts a burden upon the person who withdrew the society to prove reasonable excuse.

outcome.final_order: The final court order set aside the impugned judgment and order dated 18.10.2017 passed by Principal Judge, Family Court, District Lucknow.

use_for_drafting: representing clients in family court cases
